I've played through Fallout 3 and New Vegas extensively but I've never added any mods. What are your favorite mods?
What are the essential mods for FO3 and NV?
Most of the best mods are here. I'd recommend almost all of them if they don't cause compatibility issues.
Thanks for the link. That's a lot to check out.
Oh yea, there are a ton of mods. Those are just the most downloaded and are generally must haves.

If this is your first playthrough, I recommend sticking with mods that restore content and fix bugs rather than ones that change a lot of stuff. Therefore:

Yukichigai's Unofficial Patch - bug fixes and only bug fixes. No editorializing changes at all.

Uncut Wasteland - restores content that shipped with the game originally but was cut to make room for DLC on consoles. This is mostly cosmetic but makes the game a lot more alive -- restores miscellaneous NPCs, items in the background, electric poles, bodies of water, etc, that were removed by patches. PCs don't have the resource limitations that the 360 or PS3 have so your game can look the way it was meant to.

Strip Wall Billboards -- this is a really small mod that IMO should be part of Uncut Wasteland, by the same author. It restores some of the graphics on the billboards that line the outside walls of The Strip. I have to admit when I first saw New Vegas I didn't even know what those things were supposed to be. This restores them so they actually look like someone made a wall out of old billboard signs again.

More Where That Came From Mojave Edition - Radio New Vegas and Mojave Music Radio Expansions -- not strictly a bug fix or content restoration, but it expands the track selection of in-game radios so you won't go insane from hearing "Johnny Guitar" every 10 minutes. Absolutely essential IMO.

And that's pretty much what I used on my first playthrough.
I have played through both and much of the dlc in vanilla. That expanded radio mod would definitely be nice. Thanks.

It really depends on your style of game play. After a vanilla playthrough I play for just the fun of it. On those I always use: Willow Companion No Weapon Degradation No Addictions Collision Meshes

The most recent good mod that comes to mind is New Vegas Railroads. The NCR always boasts that they have working trains yet are never seen. It's also fun to watch things explode that get run over by the moving trains.

Call it cheesy, but this is pretty essential. There's also a Fallout 3 version. http://www.nexusmods.com/newvegas/mods/59308/

For Fallout 3, I HIGHLY recommend this: http://www.nexusmods.com/fallout3/mods/19129/? It makes combat way more tactical and challenging, even without a realistic damage mod, you'll find yourself planning out attacks more often rather than just charging in and killing everything. Whether it's just taking cover behind a good spot, or climbing up to a nearby rooftop and sniping enemies. There's a tactic to be found in a lot of places.

Alas, if you want the best of both worlds, quite literally. All you have to do is download Tale of Two Wastelands. It ports the entirety of Fallout 3 into New Vegas' engine, and allows you to travel between the two wastelands freely by train, mods for Fallout 3 are for the most part compatible after a conversion, converting a mod is relatively easy if you know the tools. There are a few tutorials out there for it.
